_comment: THE data file an operator (human or AI) edits. Windows are months: 1/3/6/12/36. P = odds (0-100) the pillar is good for crypto by then; 50 = neutral. Quality 0-1. EQUAL-WEIGHT MODEL: every pillar counts the same (1/N of the master) and shares one uniform Impact (config/settings.json 'impact'), so pillars differ ONLY by P and Quality. To add a pillar: give it a name + a quality per window here, plus a P per window in each score_set. No weight, no per-pillar impact. The quant Bitcoin-TA pillar is NEVER edited here - it is computed by the pipeline into data/pillar_scores.json and joins the equal-weight mean automatically.

2026-07-17_draft.note: July 17 catch-up re-research covering the Jul 13-17 gap (no daily runs Jul 14-16; this cycle folds in four days of primary-sourced developments flagged in the Jul 13 note as the next re-rating opportunity). Iran War Risk cut hardest (38/45/53/68/83 -> 32/39/48/65/82): the 'quiet period' hoped for did not materialize - CENTCOM ran six consecutive nights of strikes through Jul 17 (NPR/CBS/CNN/ABC/Al Jazeera, corroborated by Wikipedia's live crisis page), the US struck a maritime control tower at Chabahar and bridges/rail at Bandar Abbas with 7 confirmed killed, Iran expanded retaliation beyond Oman to Qatar, Kuwait, and Bahrain, the Strait of Hormuz has been under a disputed Iranian 'closure' since Jul 12 with the US now blockading Iranian ports, and Trump has explicitly called the ceasefire 'over'; zero reported US casualties and continuing Oman/Qatar mediation keep 36mo from falling further. Fed & Macro moved up the most of any pillar (34/36/44/53/61 -> 38/40/47/55/62) on a cluster of primary-sourced disinflationary data that landed exactly when the Jul 13 note flagged it would: BLS CPI fell 0.4% m/m in June (largest drop since Apr 2020, core flat m/m), BLS PPI fell 0.3% m/m (core PPI 4.7% y/y, below the 5.2% forecast), DOL initial claims fell to 208K (vs. 217K forecast, still 'slow hire, slow fire'), and Fed Chair Warsh's first congressional testimony (House Jul 14 / Senate Jul 15, federalreserve.gov) struck a measured inflation-fighting-but-independent tone with balance-sheet changes pre-telegraphed, not a hawkish surprise; CME FedWatch cumulative Sept hike-probability eased to ~49% (44% for 25bp + 4.7% for 50bp) from the ~62% combined read used in the Jul 11-13 baseline - a market-priced easing that corroborates the primary data. CLARITY Act nudged down at the front end only (50/54/61/82/92 -> 48/52/61/82/92): prediction-market passage odds slid further to ~43% (from ~46-47%, corroborated across Yahoo Finance, TechTimes, crypto.news, Benzinga), the merged Senate draft still omits the Democrats' ethics-provision ask, and Sens. Murphy/Van Hollen/Merkley held a press conference formally opposing the bill; no floor vote has been scheduled despite the Jul 20 target, but the structural passage case (House fast-follow, GENIUS-Act precedent) is unchanged so 6/12/36mo held. Tokenization held flat at 54/59/65/74/85: infrastructure continues to build (RWA aggregate ~$33.5B, DTCC's limited production trades launching this month on schedule) but the real catalyst - the six-agency GENIUS Act stablecoin rulemaking - has a hard Jul 18 statutory deadline that has not yet landed as of this run, so no rules-driven move is booked until they're actually finalized.
